hypothesis: A single production score may contain weak ranking information that benefits from cautious calibration rather than adding more features.
feature: Historical causal production_raw score, divided by 100; no other predictors
refit: first eligible source date each month
trainingEligibility: targetDate strictly before source date; training source date strictly earlier
slope: nonnegative; a negative fitted slope is replaced by zero without selecting a sign reversal
primaryMetric: Brier loss against same-training historical up frequency and 50:50 on identical sessions
limitations: Reuses previously reviewed 2020-2026 reconstructed scores and current price vintages; not an untouched holdout. Evaluation starts only after 252 mature reconstructed-score observations. No parameter search, production writes or modification to the frozen forward cohort.
